mostWorthwhile.text: Making the epidermal barrier was worthwhile because it showed how the outer cells and lipids slow water loss, while deeper cells replace shed cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the barrier directly to connective tissue was confusing: the need to add blood vessels first was not clear beforehand.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the barrier could not join the connective tissue until the tissue had blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: Requiring blood vessels before joining the skin layers felt somewhat arbitrary at first, even though a supplied dermis makes sense for living skin.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the completed skin to the body was satisfying, although I would hope future prerequisites are clearer.
